author: Ben

changes: Validated all compression algorithms (Gzip, Deflate, LZ4, Snappy)
Tested TAR and ZIP archive operations
Performance optimization for large data sets

description: Comprehensive compression and decompression module written in Go and compiled to WebAssembly. Supports multiple algorithms (gzip, deflate, LZ4, snappy), archive formats (TAR, ZIP), and provides advanced compression analysis including Shannon entropy calculation, compressibility classification, and multi-algorithm benchmarking. Optimized for GoWM integration.

functions.description: Compress data using gzip algorithm with configurable compression level
functions.errorPattern: Returns string with error message on failure
functions.example: const result = compress.call('gzipCompress', 'Hello World', 9); // Returns: {data, originalSize, compressedSize, compressionRatio, algorithm, level}
functions.name: gzipCompress

parameters.description: Compression level 1-9 (default: 6). Higher = better compression, slower
parameters.name: level

functions.description: Decompress gzip-compressed data from base64 encoded string

functions.example: const original = compress.call('gzipDecompress', compressedBase64); // Returns original string
